entries.spec_landed: implemented(ssid_subst=S10-a SSIT-ID 换值 at the StoreSet::violation new-SSID assignment arm (the load's freshly assigned SSIT SSID substituted with ANOTHER LEGAL live store-set ID — candidates = valid SSIT entries' SSIDs minus the true one, workbook 07 实施细则 no-random-bit-strings; the store entry keeps the true SSID), CHAOSLSQFwd chaosS10* hooks + ssit_consult(L1)/ssit_violation(L2) observations; pending: S10-b LFST target error, S10-c store-set valid loss, the other violation() merge arms as injection points (new-SSID assignment arm only), multi-field concurrent substitution; evidence: REAL RUNS, NEGATIVE — integration built it (binary 0d2f0664823f4315) and measured 6 workloads (sq_forward/gap_bfs/alias_sites/cache_dirtyevict/stream_chase/sqlite_like): attempted=4..55, arm1_events == attempted, arm1_cand_empty == arm1_events, max_live_ssids == 0, eligible == 0 everywhere. Root cause PROVEN by a probe build (removed before commit): every SSIT.findVictim victim lies OUTSIDE the calling StoreSet's own entry array (23/23) because the per-CPU SSITIndexingPolicy object is shared across MaxThreads MemDepUnits and each StoreSet::init overwrites the policy's entry-pointer table — only the last-initialised thread's SSIT is reachable, so the active thread's SSIT never validates and S10-a's 'another legal live store-set' premise is unreachable on this platform. S10 stays in MODEL_BLOCKED as BLOCKED(platform-defect: ...) — NOT a MODE-UNIMPL gap; the way out (platform fix vs spec re-scope) is an open adjudication item, see round4_findings.md §R4-5.7b and blocked_triage.md PLATFORM-DEFECT)
status_reasons: campaign:BLOCKED(platform-defect: O3 StoreSet SSIT inert — shared SSITIndexingPolicy across MaxThreads MemDepUnits makes the active thread's SSIT never validate (measured arm1_cand_empty == arm1_events, max_live_ssids == 0 on 6 workloads, 23/23 victims outside the caller's own entry array); S10-a premise unreachable — needs platform fix or re-scope, R4-5.7b)

entries.existing_coverage: 已有注入日志：CHAOSCache；CHAOSPropagation只对data/data_shift跟踪delivery，tag/valid/dirty/coh/victim仅inj节点。源码 _sources/gem5-fi-fi-ding/CHAOS/gem5/src/mem/cache/CHAOSCache 与 CHAOSPropagation。通用可直接启用：CHAOSCommitTrace(建议v2)、CHAOSMicroSnap、CHAOSProbe；源码 CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSCommitTrace|CHAOSMicroSnap|CHAOSProbe
entries.missing_hooks: 新增 CHAOSPrefetchTrace：src/mem/cache/prefetch/stride.cc::calculatePrefetch、queued.cc队列、base.cc::notify与cache request/fill/victim/writeback；为prefetch request分配pf_request_id并贯穿MSHR/fill/后续demand；把CHAOSPrefetch接入CHAOSPropagation；禁止把近似实现当作目标模型：cache dirty故障近似prefetch触发writeback时序
entries.correlation_keys: run_id + sample_run_id + fault_id/ptag；event_id + parent_event_id；tick/cycle + core_id + thread_id；dyn_inst_seq + commit_seq + PC/opcode；lq_idx/sq_idx；request_id/pf_request_id/walk_id/mshr_id/fill_id；VA/PA/cache_line；arch_reg/phys_reg。禁止只用tick或address单键连接。
entries.termination: 完整：存在L0 fault_applied，且每条边由共享键与时间/可达性同时证明，最终到达(1) errant commit/错误内存副作用/软件oracle差异，或(2)明确检测并contained，或(3)明确squash/replay/mask且无错误副作用。若链在某节点后缺事件，只能标“截至该节点可证，后续Unknown”，不得推断Masked。
